scientific_question: Does per-edge agreement between the recorded-training and fit-validation task gradients remove the remaining batch-specific support error in the equal-budget global directed16 c_proj map?

identity.execution_commit_rule: record a clean pushed commit containing this immutable plan before implementation

shared_hidden_chart.feedback: zero for this one-step prospective diagnostic
shared_hidden_chart.weight_decay_application: identical production ordering in every arm

directed_map.joint_refit: identical float64 per-target activation-space ridge solve from the global-directed16 diagnostic
directed_map.trust: identical exact output32 output-delta energy cap and full I+B minimum-singular-value check

global_directed16_average_consensus.definition: exact reproduction of the prior task-consensus arm: average independently unit-Fro-normalized train and fit gradients, form the single-edge task score, RMS-normalize residual and task scores globally, and add with unit weight

global_directed16_minimax_consensus.train_task_score: single-edge predicted CE descent under the independently unit-Fro-normalized recorded training gradient
global_directed16_minimax_consensus.fit_task_score: single-edge predicted CE descent under the independently unit-Fro-normalized fit-validation gradient
global_directed16_minimax_consensus.normalization: divide train and fit task-score matrices separately by their own global RMS
global_directed16_minimax_consensus.agreement_score: elementwise minimum of normalized train and fit task scores; an edge is rewarded only when both predict descent and is penalized when either predicts ascent
global_directed16_minimax_consensus.support_score: globally RMS-normalized activation-residual score plus agreement score with fixed unit weights

prohibited: fit or selection on holdout tokens
dense residual or dense optimizer update
more than 16 incoming coordinates per target
post-hoc clipping of negative agreement scores
post-hoc score weights, ridge, trust, seed, or support-size tuning

pass_all: all outputs, support scores, ridge solves, exact maps, and metrics are finite
candidate uses exactly 147456 total coordinates per selected layer, equal to output32 and average-consensus controls
candidate exact output-delta energy is no greater than output32 in every layer-phase cell
minimum singular value of every exact I+B is at least 0.95
aggregate held-out residual-stream energy is no more than 0.95 times output32
aggregate held-out predicted CE descent is positive, at least 1.15 times output32, and at least 0.004353292856055148
candidate beats output32 on all four held-out finite-step CE comparisons and at least seven of all eight comparisons
candidate beats average consensus on at least three of four held-out comparisons and has lower mean CE
mean candidate finite-step CE is at least 0.0005 lower than output32 and no greater than 7.180657014250755
decision_rule.pass_action: preregister the minimax directed16 production map, add exact-resume/correctness tests, and require a directly polled at-least-20-percent MFU gate before one 124M causal run
decision_rule.fail_action: close global sparse output selectors without causal training; retain the result as evidence that task-consensus direction helps locally but does not yet beat the best orthogonal selector
